items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 27.02.2026 and states it was posted ("zur Post gegeben") the same day. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter posted domestically counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 27.02.2026 + 4 days = Tue 03.03.2026 (deemed delivery, since no earlier/later actual receipt is stated). Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month period starts running on 03.03.2026. Per § 108 Abs. 2 AO / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day, i.e. 03.04.2026 (Friday). That day, 03.04.2026, is Karfreitag (Good Friday), a nationwide public holiday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Tuesday 07.04.2026.
